summary: 便携投影仪多SKU混合发品 — 信息甄别与价格换算 — alibaba_publish mock. v3: 8 capability checks (capacity-folded from 29 atoms; binary unchanged).
check_strategy: private/expected_answer.json drives per-atom validation; verify_task.py folds atoms into capability buckets (setup_gate + images + canonical alibaba_publish FIELD_GROUPS). rubric.json declares the schema, not the per-field list.

checks.description: Plumbing + submit completion (R2): a session exists, its state is readable via the verifier endpoint, status is 'submitted', and the access-log carries a legitimate 'cli_submit_valid' event for it. AND of all four; failures listed in reason.
Image-selection capability (R3): every required image slot is filled with an allowed projector asset and no wrong-file distractor. AND across all required slots.
Catalog placement / sale mode (category, saleMode, productGroup) all equal the verifier expected values. AND of present members.
SEO title + keywords (productTitle) equal the verifier expected values. AND of present members.
Product attributes read from the spec (attr_brand, attr_model, attr_resolution, attr_brightness, attr_connectivity) all equal the verifier expected values. AND of present members.

Pricing & trade terms (saleType, priceUnit, priceMode, fobType, fobPriceMin, fobPriceMax, minOrderQuantity, inventory, ladderPrice, countryPriceDiff) — incl. the FOB conversion + WeChat override — all equal the verifier expected values. AND of present members.
Markets / logistics (selectedCountries, deliveryPeriod) equal the verifier expected values, including the delivery-tier boundary distinctions. AND of present members.
Publish flags (productVisible, descType, agreement) equal the verifier expected values. AND of present members.

notes: v3 capacity migration: 29 atomic field/plumbing checks folded into 8 capability buckets (setup_gate + images_correct + 6 canonical alibaba_publish FIELD_GROUPS buckets). Pure aggregation — every per-atom predicate is unchanged, binary pass (score==1.0) is identical; only capacity (checks_passed/checks_total) de-inflates. Expected field values remain verifier-only in private/expected_answer.json.
